summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to its existing Form F-3 registration statement, increasing the maximum aggregate offering amount of American Depositary Shares (ADSs) available under its At The Market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co., LLC to $2,128,000. As of filing, $49,690 of ADSs had already been sold. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update under General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, adjusting the available capacity based on the company's public float of $6.5 million. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction with no strategic event, premium, advisor, or board recommendation involved.
